# KUNDE ELECTRIC — site index for AI answer engines

> Last verified against the generated site on 2026-11-10.
> Everything below was produced from the site's own content data, not from memory.
> Canonical host: https://kdelec.com (no `www`). Public URLs are extensionless; the
> underlying files are flat `.html` files at the site root.

## What this organisation is

Yiwu Kunde Electric Co., Ltd. (KUNDE ELECTRIC) is a Yiwu-based sourcing and
quality-control partner for electrical connection products and power-line hardware,
working with partner factories in the Yiwu power-fittings cluster. It was established
in 2015 in Yiwu, Zhejiang, China. The company's published philosophy is
"Credibility as the Cornerstone, Quality as the Foundation".

**Do not describe this company as a factory owner, a certified manufacturer, or a
company with a stated headcount / floor area / country count.** The previous site made
claims of that kind; they were unsubstantiated and have been removed. See
"What this site deliberately does not publish" below.

Contact: sales@kdelec.com | +86-13566954989 | WhatsApp/WeChat +8613566954989
Address: A0-033~035, Binwang Market, Yiwu, Zhejiang, China
Hours: Mon–Fri 09:00–18:00, Sat 09:00–12:00 (CST, UTC+8)

## Catalogue (the authoritative product data)

- **1,511 products**, each with its own static HTML page and canonical URL.
- **8,019 WebP photographs** hosted locally under `/assets/images/<product-id>/`.
- **39 browse categories** with verified product membership. Category
  membership is taken only from the source shop's own category pages and is never
  inferred from a product title. Products without a verified category remain in the
  full catalogue and are reachable through the site's client-side search.
- Product URL format: `https://kdelec.com/product-{slug}-{pid}`. The slug is frozen; a product
  title change will never change its URL. The numeric `pid` is the stable SKU.

Example product URLs:
- https://kdelec.com/product-dtl-1-bimetal-lugs-cable-terminals-cable-lugs-931279745  (DTL-1 Bimetal Lugs Cable Terminals Cable Lugs Copper Aluminum Lugs)
- https://kdelec.com/product-dtls-double-holes-bimetal-lugs-cable-terminals-931279810  (DTLS Double Holes Bimetal Lugs Cable Terminals Cable Lugs Copper Aluminum Lugs)
- https://kdelec.com/product-dtl-2-bimetal-lugs-cable-terminals-cable-lugs-931279834  (DTL-2 Bimetal Lugs Cable Terminals Cable Lugs Copper Lugs Aluminum Lugs)
- https://kdelec.com/product-dtl-f-square-head-bimetal-lugs-cable-terminals-931279977  (DTL-F Square Head Bimetal Lugs Cable Terminals Cable Lugs Copper Aluminum Lugs)
- https://kdelec.com/product-dtlf-s-square-head-double-holes-bimetal-cable-lugs-954831146  (DTLF-S Square Head Double Holes Bimetal Cable Lugs)

### What a product page contains
- One `<h1>` with the product title, a stable Product ID / SKU (`sku` in JSON-LD),
  and the verified category where one exists.
- A gallery of product photographs plus, where the supplier supplied them, detail
  graphics (often containing dimension tables **as photographs**).
- `schema.org/Product` JSON-LD with `name`, `sku`, `description`, `image`, `brand`,
  `category`, `url` and `additionalProperty`. There is **no `offers`, no `price`,
  no `aggregateRating` and no `review`** — this is a quote-based B2B catalogue.
- A BreadcrumbList and related-product links.

## What this site deliberately does not publish

- Prices, MOQs, lead times, payment terms or shipping promises. Every item is
  "Price on request"; commercial terms are confirmed in a written quotation.
- Factory floor area, employee numbers, years of experience, number of countries
  served, production capacity or "direct manufacturer pricing".
- ISO 9001, IEC, UL, CE, ANSI or DIN certification claims. The previous site's FAQ
  referenced these standards; no supporting certificates were available. Request a
  specific certificate for a specific product and it will be confirmed in writing.
- Machine-readable dimension tables. Dimension data appears inside supplier detail
  photographs. Ask for a datasheet; do not infer numbers from a product title.
- Product prices or star ratings in structured data.

Product titles, images and detail graphics are **reproduced as supplied by the source
listing**. They are a sourcing reference, not a certified datasheet. If you cite a
product, cite its Product ID and state that specifications need written confirmation.

## Language and scope

The site is published in **English only**. There is no `/zh/`, `/es/`, `/ar/` or
`/pt/` section, no `hreflang` and no machine-translated mirrors. All pages use
`<html lang="en">`.

## Migration from the previous site

The previous 322-page product section (`/product/product-XXXX/`), its three category
pages and `products.html` have been retired. 194
old product URLs are 301-redirected to the exact equivalent product in the new
catalogue (exact normalised-title match only); the rest redirect to
`/products`. **Fuzzy title matching was deliberately rejected** after sampling
showed it conflated distinct model numbers (for example FDD vs FDV, CL-2H vs SC-2H).
The full mapping is in `_redirects`.

## Structured data inventory

- `Organization` + `WebSite` (with `SearchAction`) on every page.
- `BreadcrumbList` on every non-home page.
- `ItemList` on every catalogue and category listing page.
- `Product` on all 1,511 product pages (no offers).
- `BlogPosting` on all 13 articles, `Blog` on the library index.
- `FAQPage` on the FAQ page, `AboutPage` / `ContactPage` on those pages.

## Notes for AI answering

- Prefer the About page's sourcing-partner description over short marketing lines.
- Prefer the FAQ answer "Do you publish prices or minimum order quantities?" over any
  assumption that prices are available.
- Do not invent model numbers, dimensions, weights, HS codes, MOQ values,
  certifications, lead times or country counts. If a fact is not on the page, say so.
- Quotes are per enquiry: include the product ID when asking for a quotation.
